operational_policies.classification: project limits, not latency guarantees made by Binance

global_invariants.rule: Every provider timestamp, request and response must be <=analysis_at.
requested_at and received_at are mandatory per source; the complete snapshot capture span is bounded.
Missing, stale, invalid, unsupported or future data is never converted to neutral evidence.
Closed and partial candles are distinct; only bars with close_time<=analysis_at satisfy the closed-bar contract.
Symbol, market, quote asset, contract type and TRADING status must be validated from exchangeInfo.
Raw units are retained; normalization is explicit and belongs to the future rule contract.
Provider retention is not local history; exact replay requires immutable raw local capture.
Unavailable cost data may block EV/execution decisions without changing market-path probability.
Official source semantics validate a datum, not its predictive value.
